title: Spike sorting with Kilosort4
primary_outputs: Per-unit matching accuracy, false positives and misses for the paper Kilosort4 release on three real-background IBL hybrid recordings, compared to a frozen baseline/configuration.
Accuracy versus controlled drift for paper simulations built from measured IBL waveforms; keep hybrid and fully synthesized traces distinct in reporting.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.input_scope: Three real-background IBL hybrid traces with injected spike truth at Figshare25298815v1; fully simulated drift traces are a separate semi-synthetic extension.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Reproduce the paper’s real-recording hybrid spike-sorting accuracy comparison using its three IBL hybrid datasets, with known injected spike truth; include drift-condition sensitivity as a separately labeled semi-synthetic extension. This is not complete ground truth for naturally occurring units.
unresolved_coverage: Injected spike truth supports quantitative sorter evaluation but does not label all naturally occurring neurons.
